steps.text: I can't see CarMax's prices or inventory, so I can't tell you whether this car would be cheaper there. I can only speak to Carvana. This car is $35,590. The estimated total with taxes and fees is $39,427, and delivery is Saturday. To compare, look up the same make, model, year, trim and mileage on CarMax. Then compare the total cost, not just the sticker price.
